title: Routing, Middleware & the Request Lifecycle
objectives: Use the error-handling middleware signature correctly

examples.name: app.js
examples.code:
import express from "express"
const app = express()

app.use(express.json({ limit: "1mb" }))   // parse first
app.use(requestLogger)                     // then log
app.use("/api/orders", ordersRouter)       // feature router
app.use(notFound)
app.use(errorHandler)                      // LAST: 4-arg signature

function errorHandler(err, req, res, next) {
  console.error(err)
  res.status(err.status || 500).json({ error: { message: err.message } })
}

hints: Parsing must precede handlers that read bodies.
The error handler goes last so it catches everything.

options: each middleware sees only what earlier ones passed on
questions.explanation: A json parser registered after a route means that route sees an unparsed body.

questions.prompt: Express recognizes an error handler by…
questions.explanation: The arity is the contract; register it last.
